RAG

I updated the refund policy. Why is AI still citing the old rule?

A method that retrieves relevant passages from specified material at answer time and gives them to the model·When customer support answers a refund question, RAG first finds relevant passages in connected policy material and then lets the model answer from them. New material must finish processing and enter the searchable set before later answers can use it; retrieval may still miss a passage or the model may misread it.
Know first
Context Window

Why can RAG still cite an old policy after an edit?
Support · refund question
Refund policy · teaching exampleIndex still has the old version
Policy text · Section 3Custom items cannot be returned
Customer asksCan I return my custom mug?
Passage retrievedCustom items cannot be returned
Support replyNo. Source: policy Section 3.

Teaching example: the current searchable material still contains the old clause, and the reply cites it.

Check both status and the retrieved passage

Completion is a prerequisite: After a file changes, its search index may still be processing. Completion makes the material available to search; it does not promise every query will find the right passage.

Compare the answer with its source: Check whether the retrieved passage supports the reply. Missed passages, outdated material, or a model misreading the source can still lead to an inaccurate answer.

Retrieval does not guarantee a correct answer

RAG gives retrieved material to a model as a reference. It does not guarantee the right passage is found, understood, or followed.
